sa_sajta.opis: Paket HSM Atlantic Park - Majorka - Magaluf
sa_sajta.tekst:
This hotel is situated in a quiet area, barely 400 metres away from a beautiful white sandy beach offering facilities for all kinds of water-based activities. At the same time it is very close to the resort's commercial and leisure centres with their shops, restaurants, bars, pubs and nightclubs. Aqua Park and Western Park water parks are within a 10-minute walk of the hotel and Palma de Mallorca Airport is 22 km away.
This hotel was built in 1972. Travellers can enjoy a pleasant stay in one of the 242 rooms. Guests are welcomed in the lobby, where they will find a reception desk with check-out service. The upper floors of the establishment can be accessed by lift. Amenities include a baggage storage service, a safe and a currency exchange service. Wireless internet access (no extra charge) is available to travellers in the public areas. Among the culinary options available at the accommodation are a restaurant, a bar and a beach bar. Children can have a great time playing in the playground. Additional facilities at the hotel include a playroom. Available services and facilities include multilingual staff, car hire, medical assistance and a laundry service. Active guests can make use of the bicycle hire service (for a fee) to explore the surrounding area.
